audit.why: Favoured framing is right — artillery mage with a single skillshot stun vs an all-in diver; poke early, deleted on any gap-close.
Level chart consistent across full, content and packet (Naafiri all seven rows). Spikes narrative (3-5 window, 6 dive, first item burst, late pick) matches kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text names his ultimate 'Rite of the Ancients' — the real name is Rite of the Arcane. His E Shocking Orb is his only hard CC (13s at rank 1) and his R self-immobilizes and is an interruptible channel.
audit.why: Kit file is authority on names.
Shocking Orb is 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s — the page even claims a 'fifteen-second invitation' elsewhere; 13s is the real rank-1 number.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Eviscerate for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): 13s at rank 1, 11s max — his only CC; dodge or bait it and his artillery never converts into a kill. - His W barrage cycles every 14s early. - Budget your E for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

edits.before: Q the bleed, Q the consume, E through with the pack piling — a six-body trade he answered with one rotation.
edits.after: First Q bleeds, second consumes for bonus damage and sends the pack — he cannot peel six bodies with one stun.

edits.before: W-diving into held CC — the lock-on telegraphs, the dogs can't dodge, and the lane's one button answers everything.
edits.after: Shoved blind you eat Arcanopulse and W barrages for free — push only when you intend to dive or roam off the crash.

edits.before: Xerath wins by landing Shocking Orb (Stun), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Xerath wins by landing Shocking Orb on your dive, then unloading Arcanopulse and W while you limp out of the stun.

edits.before: Trade behind the screen and bleed the contacts — your early strings out-stat most of the lane's expectations.
edits.after: Stand behind minions — Arcanopulse and Shocking Orb both stop on the wave — and bleed him whenever he steps up.

edits.before: You are the flank with a head count: R the approach, W through the front line, and let the hounds peel-proof the exit.
edits.after: Late he sieges from 1000+ range with zero escape — flank from fog, R him the moment the stun whiffs, and the fight is 4v5.

edits.before: His R Rite of the Ancients pokes from screen-range but does nothing to stop a committed dive. At 6 your ult's speed and extra Packmates let you cross his zone and delete him the moment his E stun is down.
edits.after: His R Rite of the Arcane roots him in place to poke from screen-range and does nothing to stop a dive. At 6 your ult's speed and extra Packmates let you cross his zone and delete him the moment his E stun is down.

notes: Fixed fabricated ult name (Rite of the Ancients -> Rite of the Arcane), all three lintFindings, and grounded the templated enemyWin/early/late fields in his actual kit (minion-blocked Q/E, self-root R, no escape). UNVERIFIED: the page repeatedly calls Naafiri's W a 'lock-on dive/dash' (spikes[0] 'W-dash the gap'), but the kit file's W text describes only untargetability, packmates and move speed with no dash — left those claims alone rather than rewrite on uncertain mechanics; flag for a human check of the current W. dosFull[2].d claims a 'fifteen-second invitation' for Shocking Orb; real CD is 13-11s — left as-is (enum-adjacent short prose, minor), noted here.
